description: This Dart file implements the login screen for a Flutter application, handling user authentication via password or OTP, with form validation, UI interactions, and navigation logic.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the login interface, enabling user login via password or OTP, and navigates to dashboard upon successful login.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the login form, user input, validation, API interactions, and navigation logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers when the widget is removed from the tree.

methods.name: _validateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates whether the identifier is a valid email or phone number.

methods.name: _validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password input for minimum length.

methods.name: _validateOtp
methods.description: Validates the OTP input for correct number length.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP from the API for the provided identifier.

methods.name: _login
methods.description: Performs login using email/phone and password or OTP, updates session token, and navigates upon success.
